items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: she was in the picture and so was Victoria Spivey in the picture. So after she made the picture, she came to Dallas and got this revue... we were on a tour and we went to Tulsa, Oklahoma... in the lobby, had a big baby grand in the lobby, and musicians would come in and jam.

ctx.x: Yeah, we was listening to Fletcher. And McKinney's Cotton Pickers --
